email.subject: Quick fix for Peak Fitness's website
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I took a look at Peak Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: there's no click-to-call button, so anyone searching on their phone has to copy and dial your number manually, and most give up. The homepage title also doesn't mention Harbor Falls or fitness, so you're probably getting buried in local search results.

Both are quick, flat-fee fixes.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I found and what it'd take to fix? No pressure either way.

Alex
